credentials.title: TTLock credentials
credentials.description: Enter the pairing credentials for {name}. These come from the paired lock's data (aes_key and unlock_key).

error.invalid_aes_key: The AES key must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes).
error.invalid_unlock_key: The unlock key must be a whole number between 1 and 4294967295. It is the `unlock_key` from the lock's data, not `admin_ps`.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured TTLock devices were found.

init.title: TTLock BLE options
init.description: Tune how hard the integration tries to reach the lock. Raise these if commands fail on a weak signal or when a Bluetooth proxy runs out of connection slots.

data_description.connect_attempts: How many times to connect and run a command before giving up. Each retry waits longer than the last.
data_description.command_timeout: How long to wait for each response from the lock before treating the attempt as failed.
